title: Tallinn Music Week 2027 artist applications
cost_warning: Selected artists receive festival and conference passes; the source does not state a performance fee or travel support.
summary: Artists of any genre and country may apply to perform at the 8–10 April 2027 discovery festival in Tallinn.
eligibility: Artists worldwide; must be able to perform in Tallinn.

title: Sounds of the Future Residency
organizer: Sound Art Lab, SPOR festival and Danish Composers’ Society
cost_warning: Application portal is unavailable until 1 November during Koda's system transition.
summary: A three-week residency with a DKK 30,000 work grant, studio and equipment access, and accommodation.
eligibility: Artists living in Denmark or strongly connected to the Danish sound-art scene.

title: Play NXNE 2027
cost_warning: Selected acts choose a CAD $150 band / $100 solo fee or an artist VIP package; travel and lodging support are not stated.
summary: Apply for a showcase at NXNE in Toronto, 16–20 June 2027; every submission is reviewed by the programming team.
eligibility: Artists able to perform in Toronto.

title: New York City Electroacoustic Music Festival 2027
fee: No submission fee; about US $350 mandatory if accepted
cost_warning: Important: accepted artists must pay an approximately US $350 registration fee whether or not they attend; performers and large instruments cost extra. Students may qualify for 50% off.
summary: Submit fixed-media, live-electronic, mixed, multimedia or installation work for the 15–21 June 2027 festival.
eligibility: Open worldwide, regardless of age or career stage.

title: European Music Collective at Kintai Music Festival
fee: No application fee stated; selected participants pay €25
cost_warning: There is no composition or performance fee. Composer-performers receive accommodation, but travel, meals, and local expenses are not covered; selected participants pay €25.
summary: Composers may propose an unpremiered work for the ensemble; composer-performers with improvisation experience may also join the 1–9 August 2027 festival.
eligibility: Composers; or composer-performers other than pianists and drummers. No geographic restriction stated.

title: A Gift Without Name compilation
cost_warning: No royalties or other payment. Artists keep ownership, grant no exclusivity, and can request removal.
summary: Submit a sound work responding to the 'A Gift Without Name' theme for a free/name-your-price digital compilation due 4 December 2026.
eligibility: Ambient, drone, experimental electronics, field recording, musique concrète, noise, acousmatic and related sound artists.

title: MISE-EN Festival 2027 — Call for Scores
cost_warning: Selected composers must attend in New York; travel support is generally unavailable.
summary: Scores, fixed media, audiovisual pieces, live electronics, performances and related projects are welcome for the 15–19 June 2027 festival.
eligibility: Composers worldwide who can attend the New York festival in person.

title: MISE-EN Festival 2027 — Student Composer Internship
cost_warning: Shared housing is provided, but travel and other expenses are not covered.
summary: Student composers propose a new ensemble work, join rehearsals and festival operations, and receive a premiere plus shared housing.
eligibility: Student composers able to attend in New York from 14–20 June 2027.

title: Electric Sky 2027 artist applications
organizer: Electric Sky Electronic Music & Arts Festival
cost_warning: The organizer has not published a closing date or compensation details on the application landing page; verify before committing travel.
summary: Applications are open for the electronic music mainstage and SOL stage, plus performance and workshop roles.
eligibility: Not stated on the public landing page.
